description: This Kotlin source file defines DashboardFragment, an Android Fragment responsible for displaying AI-powered recommendations and quick actions in the app's home UI. It renders headers, informational texts, and quick action buttons, and asynchronously fetches suggested files using AiCategorizer to present them in the interface.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays AI recommendations and quick actions on the home screen.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of DashboardFragment.

methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, including headers, info texts, and quick action buttons, and starts AI suggestions retrieval.

methods.description: Adds a header TextView to the container.

methods.description: Adds informational TextView to the container.

methods.name: renderQuickActions
methods.description: Creates and adds quick action buttons for sharing and connecting cloud storage.

methods.name: runAi
